name: Tanmay Tiwari
tagline: Making the web a little more human.
bio: I’m a creative developer who enjoys the full product experience—from sturdy engineering to the small visual details that make an interface feel alive. I co-founded HackShastra, a student-builder community where people learn together and turn early ideas into real projects. Whether I’m shaping a product or bringing people together, I want the web to feel more human and more inviting to build with.
heroTitle: With great code comes great possibility.
